name: V-Sync Toggle
description: Changes the graphics driver's global V-Sync setting for the length of the stream, then restores the previous setting. Supports NVIDIA GPUs (using vsync-toggle) and AMD GPUs (using the driver's Wait for Vertical Refresh setting).
author: Sunshine

options.label: V-Sync during the stream
options.description: Global V-Sync setting to use while streaming. On AMD GPUs, Fast Sync is applied as On, and "Let the application decide" means Off unless the application asks for V-Sync.
